blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. A student's work is on the screen, line one at the top. Which line is the first one that is wrong?
The student distributed negative three, but negative three times negative two is positive six, not negative six. So line two is wrong.
The next step adds six to both sides. That is fine on its own, but it carries the error.
Dividing by negative three flips the symbol, so this step is fine on its own too, but it carries the error.
So the answer is line two.
Watch out for these traps. If you point at the final answer, you get four. If you blame the line after the mistake, you get three.
